case_title: VIVEK DELHIKAR VS. INNA KATHRYN DAGEN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $725.00 FILED BY DELHIKAR, VIVEK AS TO DEFENDANT DAGEN, INNA KATHRYN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-01-2019 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $0.00 SERVED AUG-12-2019, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT DAGEN, INNA KATHRYN
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM JUDGE.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-01-2019 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO DEC-05-2019 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF VIVEK DELHIKAR IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT INNA KATHRYN DAGEN IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED. PARTIES AGREE TO A PAYMENT PLAN. DEFENDANT AGREES TO PAY $100.00 A WEEK FOR 8 WEEKS. THE FIRST PAYMENT IS DUE ON 10-11-19. SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS OF $100.00 TO BE EVERY FRIDAY THEREAFTER. ALL PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE TO THROUGH VENMO. FINAL PAYMENT DUE ON NOV-29, 2019 FOR A FINAL AMOUNT OF $125.00. PROGRESS REPORT IS SET FOR DEC-5-2019 AT 3:30 P.M. DEPT. 506. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID LAVINE; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. MATTER CONTINUED TO DEC-05-2019 AT 3:30 P.M. IF NO APPEARANCE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE.

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PLAINTIFF VIVEK DELHIKAR IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT INNA KATHRYN DAGEN IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF STATED THE DEFENDANT PAID AGREED AMOUNT BUT THE PLAINTIFF WANTED TO CONTINUE CASE TO ADD ON COSTS WHICH WERE NOT NEOGIATED IN THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. HONORABLE A.JAMES ROBERTSON II WOULD NOT ALLOW A CHANGE TO THE AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
